fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Access Drive; Access Drive; Open Terrain; Detached Garage; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Post structure identification markers on each detached building so responders can quickly distinguish between them on arrival.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sightlines and at least 14 feet of vertical clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Clear a designated turnaround area near the end of the access drive so emergency vehicles can reposition without backing a long distance.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and each detached structure so responders can move on foot between buildings without pushing through dense vegetation.
• Cut back shrubs or low branches that overhang or crowd either side of the access drive.
• Keep all gates along the access drive unlocked or equipped with a Knox-type lock accessible to emergency responders.
• Mark or post a simple site map at the driveway entrance showing the location and layout of all structures on the property.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Vegetation Near Structure; Long Driveway; Single Access Route; Grass Cover; Tree Cluster; Limited Vegetation Separation; Scattered Trees; Open Clearing
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang directly over or touch the roof and walls of the structure.
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's exterior walls.
• Cut grass around the structure short, particularly in the area immediately surrounding the building.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot move directly from low plants up into the tree canopy.
• Clear dead grass, dry leaves, and loose plant debris from around the base of the structure.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of overhanging branches low enough to block emergency vehicle access.
• Trim back any shrubs or grass that have grown into the driveway travel lane along its entire length.
• Maintain the open clearing near the structure free of encroaching shrubs and woody plants.
• Remove any wood piles, loose lumber, or stored materials placed against or directly beside the structure.
• Thin scattered trees between the structure and the driveway to keep sight lines and movement paths open.
• Keep vegetation cut back along both sides of the driveway to maintain a clear path for vehicles to turn around or pass.
